title: Take-Two takes legal action against GTA 6 leakers and subpoenas Microsoft and Discord
summary: The publisher pursues those responsible for massive gameplay leaks as new videos keep surfacing and fraudulent cryptocurrency schemes are detected.

title: FromSoftware cancels The Duskbloods network test after massive connection failures
summary: The multiplayer test for FromSoftware's new title shuts down after two hours due to server issues, and the studio apologizes while rescheduling sessions.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners confirms second season for October with new trailer and protagonists
summary: Netflix and CD Projekt reveal release date, preview, and details of the continuation of the acclaimed anime set in Night City.

title: Compulsion Games becomes independent from Xbox and regains rights to its games
summary: The studio behind South of Midnight separates from Microsoft while retaining ownership of its titles and plans to self-fund its next project.

title: Mortal Shell 2 reduces enemy health following player criticism
summary: Developers adjust game balance in an update that eases excessive difficulty, except for a final boss.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 brings back controversial 'Dead Man's Hand' item with major changes
summary: The new CoD beta reintroduces the controversial killstreak with adjustments, while early reviews highlight its similarity to previous entries.

title: Dave Bautista to play Kratos in Amazon's God of War series
summary: The actor and former wrestler confirms his casting to portray the Spartan in the television adaptation produced by Amazon Prime Video.

title: 25th Anniversary translucent Xbox Series X will cost $900 and launch on Black Friday
summary: Microsoft announces a special transparent green edition with a premium price, comparable to a PS5 Pro, to celebrate its quarter century.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 arrives with MGS4 and forgotten gems like Snake's Revenge
summary: The collection includes the acclaimed Guns of the Patriots and rare titles, though the absence of MGS4 on PC sparks debate.

title: Nintendo intensifies war against Switch emulators with 400 new GitHub takedowns
summary: The company files mass DMCA requests against emulator repositories, while warning users of legal consequences.

title: Marvel's Wolverine goes gold and will be a timed PS5 exclusive
summary: Insomniac Games completes development of the mutant's game, with launch planned on PlayStation 5 before arriving on other platforms.

title: Riot Games cancels development of 2XKO, its League of Legends fighting game, after less than a year
summary: The studio shuts down the project due to unsustainable operating costs and will refund players who purchased content.

title: Genki Manta controller integrates own screen and advanced haptics in compact design
summary: The new gamepad for Switch and PC stands out for its rear touchscreen, haptic feedback, and long-lasting battery.

title: Double Fine regains ownership of Psychonauts and its games after separating from Xbox
summary: Tim Schafer's studio becomes independent again and will receive all revenue from its titles published under Microsoft.
